description: PHP script for handling WPS configuration actions such as enabling/disabling WPS, setting WPS methods, pairing clients via push button or PIN, and canceling sessions. It interacts with device settings through setStr calls and processes configuration data received via POST.

methods.name: validChecksum
methods.description: Validates WPS PIN checksum for either 4 or 8 digit PINs.

methods.name: MiniApplySSID
methods.description: Applies settings to a specific SSID based on its number.
